**Limitations**

- The quality must be known or guessed.
- Does not model chroma subsampling, so color blocks of 16 x 16 pixels stay partly.
- Assumes the block grid starts at the top left pixel. Cropped JPEGs can be off the grid.

**Artifacts**

- Slight blur of fine texture when the quality is set too low.
